spin-master.name: Spin Master

trail.detail: Canadian company, TSX: TOY. Chief executive since July 2025: Christina Miller; board leadership shared between co-founders including Ronnen Harary (chair per company materials) and Anton Rabie.

facts.text: Christina Miller appointed CEO, succeeding Max Rangel; announced by the company.

trail.detail: Co-founder of Spin Master (1994). His personal charity, the Ronnen Harary Foundation, is the documented link.

facts.text: The Canadian BDS Coalition documents the foundation funding the Jerusalem Municipality and support for Israeli soldiers, and calls for a boycott of Spin Master over it.

The coalition reports Harary's sister charity, 1 R32 Foundation, publicised feeding IDF soldiers ahead of the ground invasion of Gaza in late 2023, and asks Canadian authorities to audit both charities. Harary has also personally delivered supplies to army bases.

trail.detail: No documented corporate operations, investment or statements tying the company itself to Israel or the settlements were found. The documented link is the founder's personal philanthropy, which is why the boycott call targets the company's revenue rather than recorded corporate conduct.

unknowns: Whether the Ronnen Harary Foundation continues this funding in 2026: the coalition's documentation dates from 2024.
Spin Master's charitable giving through its corporate foundation (The Toy Movement) has not been audited for Israel-related grants in the sources found.

ms-rachel.name: Ms. Rachel toys

trail.detail: Children's educator with 16M+ subscribers. A leading pro-Palestinian voice in US entertainment.
trail.pos: This is one of the rare toys whose face belongs to someone punished, not promoted, for standing with Palestine. Her record is below.

facts.text: Said she is willing to risk her career to keep advocating for children in Gaza.
Pledged $1 million to the Palestine Children's Relief Fund, matching Macklemore's donation, and urged other celebrities to speak out against the genocide in Gaza.

trail.detail: Her toy line is made under licence by Spin Master, whose co-founder's charity funded the Jerusalem Municipality and IDF soldier support, prompting a coalition boycott call.

facts.text: Canadian BDS Coalition boycott call over Ronnen Harary's foundation.

trail.pos: Her royalties fund the brand; the manufacturing money flows to Spin Master. Buying second-hand or alternatives, and donating the difference to PCRF, supports her work without the licensee link.

trail.detail: Pro-Israel groups have petitioned the Justice Department to investigate her Gaza advocacy, and named her to an 'Antisemite of the Year' list. Her account once liked an antisemitic comment by accident, which she apologised for.

facts.text: StopAntisemitism asked the US Attorney General to investigate her posts on Gaza children as 'propaganda'.

unknowns: The exact royalty split between Accurso and Spin Master has not been made public.
Counterfeit Ms. Rachel toys are widespread, with unknown manufacturing chains entirely.

mattel.name: Mattel

trail.detail: US company (NASDAQ: MAT). Chairman and CEO: Ynon Kreiz, Israeli-American, who grew up in Israel.

facts.text: Kreiz spoke of the war as personal, telling Yahoo Finance 'As an Israeli, this is personal'.
Kreiz joined 15 entertainment industry leaders in a joint statement denouncing the Hamas attacks, and signed the Creative Community for Peace open letter supporting Israel.

trail.detail: The Mattel Children's Foundation directed humanitarian cash and toy donations toward shelters and hospitals in Israel after October 2023. Mattel is not on the BDS movement's official target lists.

facts.text: Company statement describing the foundation's post-October 7 humanitarian focus on Israeli shelters and hospitals.

unknowns: No documented donation by Mattel to Israeli state or military bodies was found; the documented acts are the CEO's signature on advocacy letters and humanitarian giving.
Sponsorship of the 2024 Israel Film Festival is claimed by boycott-list sites but not confirmed against primary sources.

disney.name: Disney toys

trail.detail: Most 'Disney' toys are made by licensees (Mattel holds several, plus Jakks Pacific), but the brand, characters and royalties belong to Disney.

facts.text: Donated $2 million to humanitarian relief in Israel, including Magen David Adom, with Bob Iger's statement framing it around the attacks on Israel.

trail.detail: Disney+ has been a BDS consumer boycott target, and the movement publicly renewed its Disney boycott over the inclusion of Sabra, a pro-Israel comic character, in Captain America: Brave New World.

facts.text: BDS reiterated its Disney boycott after Marvel revived the Sabra character.

unknowns: How much of a licensed Disney toy's price reaches Disney as royalty is not published.
Licensee conduct varies: a Disney toy made by Mattel carries both companies' records.

hasbro.name: Hasbro

facts.text: The Toy Foundation, the toy industry's collective charity, mobilised donations amid the Israel-Hamas war; industry-wide rather than a Hasbro corporate act.

src.t: Toy industry reporting via boycott lists

trail.detail: No documented donation, statement or operation tying Hasbro as a company to Israel or the occupation was found in the sources checked. Consumer boycott threads exist on social media, but none anchor to a primary source. Absence of evidence is not innocence.

unknowns: Executive philanthropy of Hasbro leadership has not been examined in the sources found.
Hasbro's licensing web (Disney, Marvel) means some Hasbro products carry Disney's documented ties.

lego.name: LEGO

facts.text: LEGO's documented Israel activity is commercial: retail stores opening in Israeli cities. No corporate donation, statement or military tie was found, and LEGO is not on the BDS movement's target lists.

trail.detail: Nothing documented. Watch the licence web: LEGO Star Wars and LEGO Marvel pay royalties to Disney, which carries documented ties. Absence of evidence is not innocence.

unknowns: Whether LEGO's mall and retail partners in Israel include settlement locations was not verifiable in the sources found.

mga.name: MGA Entertainment

trail.detail: Iranian-born American founder and CEO of MGA, the largest privately held toy company.

facts.text: Profiled by Reverse Canary Mission as publicly supporting Zionist figures and narratives on his personal LinkedIn. This source is a single activist-run database and its characterisations could not be independently confirmed; treated as weak.

trail.detail: No documented corporate donation or operation tying MGA to Israel was found. The only signal is the founder's personal social-media activity, which is thin ground for a boycott call.

unknowns: Larian's charitable giving has not been documented in the sources found.
Note: Larian has an independently documented record of public attacks on a Black artist and on Black Lives Matter (Bloomberg, 2020), which may matter to buyers weighing the company overall.

dr-zigs.name: Dr Zigs

trail.detail: Small independent Welsh company founded in 2011 by Paola Dyboski-Bryant. Giant bubble toys and mixes are made by hand at its Bubble HQ in North Wales; the founder owns the company, with no parent company behind it.
trail.pos: This is the opposite case to most entries here: a toy company with a documented, public record of standing with Palestine.

facts.text: Company background: started at home in Tregarth in 2011, grown to around 11 employees, still manufacturing in North Wales.
Companies House record: Dr Zigs Ltd, company number 09083207, registered at Vaynol Estate, Bangor, Gwynedd, with Paola Dyboski-Bryant as director.

trail.detail: The company's position is stated on its own shopfront, in its own words, not inferred from anyone else.

facts.text: The Dr Zigs website states the company is 'proudly pro-Palestine' and stands for Palestinian freedom, dignity and children's rights, including every child's freedom to play.

trail.detail: A project run through Dr Zigs for 15 years, which became an independent nonprofit in 2026, bringing play to children in war zones and displacement camps.

facts.text: Bubble kits from the project were aboard the Global Sumud Flotilla, the aid mission attacked by Israeli forces as it tried to break the blockade of Gaza, and kits have since reached children in Gaza displacement camps.
The project distributes kits in Gaza and Lebanon and has begun reaching children in Myanmar and Cox's Bazaar, with Sudan, Congo and Tigray planned.

unknowns: No boycott call exists and none is called for: everything documented points the other way.
Dr Zigs registered a French arm in 2021 to keep EU trade working after Brexit; manufacturing stayed in North Wales, and no Israel-facing operations were found in the sources checked.
